data.title: Car accident claim – liability accepted by other driver's insurer
data.summary: Beispiel Assekuranz AG, the liability insurer for the other driver in your 19 September 2025 car park accident, confirms that their policyholder has accepted liability. They cover the damage to your vehicle under the driver's liability insurance and ask you to send a repair cost estimate and photos of the damage within 12 working days of this letter (dated 29 September 2025).
data.explanation: This is good news: the other driver's insurer has accepted responsibility for the accident and will pay for the damage to your car under their liability insurance. You need to send them a repair cost estimate (Kostenvoranschlag) and photos of the damage by the deadline shown in the app. If the damage exceeds €1,000, you may instead submit an independent expert's report (Gutachten) of your choice, and the insurer will pay for that report too. If you cannot meet the deadline, contact the insurer to ask for more time; for significant damage an independent assessment can be worthwhile.

key_facts.label: Deadline to submit cost estimate and photos
key_facts.value: 12 Werktage nach dem Datum dieses Schreibens
key_facts.quote: Schicken Sie uns den Kostenvoranschlag und Fotos der Schäden bitte innerhalb von 12 Werktagen nach dem Datum dieses Schreibens (Werktage sind Montag bis Samstag; Sonntage und gesetzliche Feiertage zählen nicht mit).

key_facts.label: Threshold for independent expert report (Gutachten)
key_facts.quote: Bei Schäden über 1.000 € können Sie statt des Kostenvoranschlags auch ein Gutachten eines Sachverständigen Ihrer Wahl einreichen; die Kosten dafür tragen wir.
